1512:    ) -> tuple[int, Optional[tuple[MessageEntity, ...]]]:
1513:        """
1514:        Use this function to compute position and entities of a quote in the message text or
1515:        caption. Useful for filling the parameters
1516:        :paramref:`~telegram.ReplyParameters.quote_position` and
1517:        :paramref:`~telegram.ReplyParameters.quote_entities` of :class:`telegram.ReplyParameters`

1520:        Example:
1521:
1522:            Given a message with the text ``"Hello, world! Hello, world!"``, the following code
1523:            will return the position and entities of the second occurrence of ``"Hello, world!"``.
1524:
1525:            .. code-block:: python

1538:            tuple[:obj:`int`, :obj:`None` | tuple[:class:`~telegram.MessageEntity`, ...]]: On
1539:            success, a tuple containing information about quote position and entities is returned.

1542:            RuntimeError: If the message has neither :attr:`text` nor :attr:`caption`.
1543:            ValueError: If the requested index of quote doesn't exist in the message.

1569:                # trim the entity length to the length of the overlap with the quote
